set.body: Acceptance criteria: Recording construction rejects or explicitly normalizes non-finite tracked coordinates, points outside the declared frame, and invalid pupil values with indexed named errors; fixed-rate recordings prove timestamp compatibility under a named tolerance or require an explicit resampling artifact; None pupil and invalid numeric pupil states cannot collide in persistent content identity; tests include invalid points, off-surface normalization policy, pupil edge cases, and nominal-rate mismatch mutants.
set.title: Validate trusted recordings and declared sampling
